description: Active monthly rows after the month of last_active_date
last_active_date earlier than the user's latest funnel event (on/before snapshot)
treatment: last_active_date_adj = max(last_active_date, latest as-of funnel event); days_inactive_adj recomputed

description: Pre-computed summary KPIs that do not reproduce from row-level data
treatment: All KPIs recomputed from row-level data. Mismatches: Analysis: 30d churn proxy; Analysis: blended CAC (all users); Funnel: churn proxy count. 'Blended CAC' = spend / paid-channel users only (excl. organic).

description: Users flagged neither active_30d nor churned_30d_proxy although tenure>=30 d (boundary)
treatment: eligible_30d redefined as tenure>=31 so that '>30 days inactive' is observable; 21 users with tenure=30 treated as not yet eligible

description: Users with last_active_date in Jul-Oct 2026 (every user has one) but no active month Jul-Oct in Monthly_Activity
treatment: Max observable inactivity is 120 days (no user is older), so churned_90d_proxy is bounded and under-states long-run inactivity. Treated as a recency proxy; long-run engagement from cohort retention

description: First deposit above Tukey fence on raw scale (Rs 22,944)
treatment: flag_deposit_outlier_iqr=1. Log-normal body (log-skew ~0): extremes are legitimate right-tail values, not errors

description: First deposit above Tukey fence on log scale (Rs 62,936)
treatment: flag_deposit_outlier_log=1. Almost nothing is an outlier once the skew is respected

description: Monthly trading value above Tukey fence on raw scale (Rs 30,365)
treatment: flag_trading_value_outlier_iqr=1. Log-normal body: legitimate active-trader tail

description: Monthly trading value above Tukey fence on log scale (Rs 105,451)
Average trade size above log-scale fence (Rs 35,759)
Resolution time above Tukey fence (27.9 h)
treatment: flag_resolution_outlier=1. Long tail is expected in service data; use median alongside mean

description: Cumulative withdrawals exceed cumulative deposits in a user-month (informational)
treatment: flag_cum_withdrawal_exceeds_deposits=1; do not use for cash-balance analysis

description: Rebuilt cohort table vs supplied Cohort_Retention sheet (cohort size & active users, per cell)
Recomputed CAC vs supplied Campaigns.cac_inr (paid campaigns)
treatment: CAC reproduces. Supplied cost-per-KYC / cost-per-first-trade use eventual (flag) completions; new *_asof columns use on-snapshot events and *_at_maturity columns use mature-cohort rates
